spatialNovelty.rule: Connected components include both primary and auxiliary historical ancestry. A scout component is spatially novel only when it has no ancestry edge and no bidirectional trajectory-overlap edge to any consumed historical component. Conservative sensitivity additionally joins near starts.

visualNovelty.representation: clean ultrasound converted to grayscale, bilinear resize to 128x128, values in [0,1]
visualNovelty.rendererNoiseSource: G2-R3-A2 already-consumed repeat-render per-case summaries; locked/confirmation images are never opened by R5
visualNovelty.rule: Image-hash uniqueness never establishes novelty. A credible scout component needs at least one clean image whose minimum RMS distance to every indexed historical image is strictly above the frozen renderer-noise cutoff. Credible components counted together must also have representative images separated pairwise above that cutoff.

labels.positive: finalTargetAcceptable is true and score.total >= acceptableScoreFloor
labels.negative: finalTargetAcceptable is false and score.total < acceptableScoreFloor

decisionRule.GO_BOUNDED_DEVELOPMENT_CAPTURE: Integrity and budgets pass; at least three primary-spatially novel, visually novel positive-reachable components and at least three primary-spatially novel, visually novel negative components exist; their union contains at least six components; at least one counted negative component contains a hard negative; and the snapshot documents a safe justified route for increasing independent support.
decisionRule.FEASIBILITY_INCONCLUSIVE: Integrity passes and physically valid scout evidence exists, but the predeclared GO support is not established and evidence does not prove current-anatomy diversity insufficient.
decisionRule.INSUFFICIENT_DIVERSITY_ON_CURRENT_ANATOM: Integrity passes, but valid proposals/routes collapse into historical or mutually overlapping components, or their ultrasound differences remain at/below the frozen renderer-noise cutoff, such that useful independent support is demonstrably insufficient.
decisionRule.ENGINEERING_OR_INTEGRITY_BLOCKED: The immutable snapshot, source/scene/evaluator identity, budget, hashes, label/floor agreement, physical validity, or required contract fields fail verification.
